title: SemEval-2026 Task 9: Detecting Multilingual, Multicultural and Multievent Online Polarization
reasoning: The paper includes a specific subtask (Subtask 2: POLARTYPE) to identify the social dimension underlying polarization, with 'religious' as one of the core categories.
